Class.name: IHC.EAI.KPI.Service.API.Metrics
Class.Description: REST service API for ITF Metrics

XData.name: UrlMap
XData.Data: <Routes> <Route Url="/count/transaction/" Method="PUT" Call="CreateTransactionCount"/> <Route Url="/count/component/" Method="PUT" Call="CreateComponentCount"/> <Route Url="/healthCheck/" Method="GET" Call="HealthCheck"/> </Routes>

Method.name: CreateTransactionCount
Method.Description:
This method creates a transaction count record
Return a json representation of persistent obj

Method.name: CreateComponentCount
Method.Description:
This method creates a component count record
Return a json representation of persistent obj

Method.name: HealthCheck
Method.Description:
This method provides a service health check for consumers
Return a json array stating the system is up and running
